traditions.r: Cantal and Aubrac, Massif Central, France
traditions.p: Ancient; Salers produced for at least 2,000 years
traditions.d: Summer cheesemaking in stone mountain huts (burons) from pasture milk, producing large pressed tommes such as Salers and Laguiole.
traditions.tech: Raw milk renneted in a wooden gerle, curd pressed uncooked in large moulds, cave-matured
traditions.mat: Raw Salers, Aubrac or Simmental cows' milk
traditions.auth: PDO name on the rind; Salers only farmhouse-made between 15 April and 15 November; Laguiole bears a bull stamp and aluminium plaque.

traditions.d: Pastoral method of ripening salted, crumbled curd packed into a cleaned animal skin stored in caves or cellars.
traditions.tech: Curd drained, brined, kneaded with raw milk and packed tightly into a salted skin, then cellar-ripened for months
traditions.mat: Goat's or sheep's milk; goat, sheep or calf skin
traditions.auth: Ripened in real skin rather than plastic barrels; regional geographical-indication names such as Erzincan tulum.

notes: Shelf 'Regional pressed cheese' rebuilt: 5 kinds (Cantal & Salers, Pyrenean sheep cheese [new], Greek hard cheese [new], Tulum & skin-ripened cheese, Roomi), 18 archetypes, 4 brands, 2 traditions. Old 'Other tomme-type cheese' (k76, ~190 models) dissolved: Cantal, Salers, Laguiole PDO and 'Auvergne Salers Breed Cheeses' became archetypes/versions here; Agour Ossau-Iraty became an Ossau-Iraty version; 'Divle Cave-Aged Cheese' a Tulum version; 'Basque Pyrenees Mountain Cheeses' and 'Béarn High Pasture Cheeses' are covered by Ossau-Iraty fermier/estive. Other protected names belong on other workers' family shelves: Italian (Castelmagno, Bra, Raschera, Valtellina Casera, Monte Veronese, Casciotta d'Urbino, Salva Cremasco, Spressa, Stelvio, Formaggella del Luinese, Fromadzo, Bagòss, Silter, Maiorchino, Piacentinu Ennese…) → Italian shelf; Spanish/Portuguese/Latin American (Arzúa-Ulloa, Tetilla, Mahón, Majorero, Palmero, Flor de Guía, Ibores, Murcia, Casín, Los Beyos, Nata de Cantabria, Liébana, São Jorge, Pico, Nisa, Évora, Rabaçal, Terrincho, Beira Baixa, Transmontano, Minas/Serro/Canastra, Colonial, Paipa, Tafí del Valle…) → Spanish, Portuguese & Latin American; British PDOs (Swaledale, Staffordshire, Dunlop, Teviotdale, White Stilton, Imokilly Regato) → Cheddar & British / Blue; Morbier, Tête de Moine, Vacherin fribourgeois → Alpine; Danbo, Svecia, Boeren Leyden → Dutch & Nordic. Central European GIs (Liliputas, Csemege, Tekovský, Livanjski, Nanoški, Gailtaler Almkäse) and Pag cheese have no planned kind — flagged for the cheese lead. About 95 one-producer SKUs with no reference record (e.g. Abuelo Ruperto, Parish Hill Humble, Cornish Kern, L'ovella del Pirineu, Goustal) dropped. Roncal and Idiazábal stay on the Spanish shelf. Left blank as unconfirmed: founding years of Savencia and Jeune Montagne; launch years of Etorki and Abbaye de Belloc. The wiki/wikidata helper tools failed (lock-directory error), so every source was retrieved with web_fetch.
